Car towing and recovery in Iskandar Puteri

Broken down or the car will not start? Our Facebook page lists recovery towing alongside maintenance and repair.

What to send

Call or WhatsApp 011-6776 1138 with where you are, the car model and what happened. A pin from your phone helps.

Straight to the bay

Recovered cars come to our workshop in Taman Bukit Indah, where we scan and check them.

WhatsApp 011-6776 1138Call

Questions drivers ask

Which areas do you cover?

Our workshop is in Taman Bukit Indah, Iskandar Puteri, Johor Bahru. Call or WhatsApp with your location to check.

How much does towing cost?

It depends on the distance and the car. Call or WhatsApp with your location and ask for a price.
